svg.text: #591 Enterprise Browser-Use & Computer-Use Agent: Hybrid AXTree/DOM + Vision Fallback Sizing
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 85% Pruned AXTree (380ms) + 15% Vision CUA Fallback (UI-TARS) · 3.67x Faster (9.8s vs. 36s) · -79.5% Cost
1. Why 100% Screenshot CUA Fails on Enterprise ERP Flows
✕ Naive 100% Screenshot Vision CUA (15-Step ERP Workflow)
• Sends 1920×1080 PNG (2,650 visual tokens) at every click/type step
• Total Latency: 36.0s/task (2.4s/step) · Cost: $0.210/task · Success: 84.2%
✓ Hybrid AXTree-First (85%) + Set-of-Marks Vision Fallback (15%)
• Fast Path (85% Steps): Extract Pruned Accessibility Tree (680 text tokens)
→ Qwen2.5-32B-FP8 selects [backend_node_id] in 380ms/step (Zero pixel drift!)
• Vision Fallback (15% Steps): Trigger UI-TARS-7B/14B + Set-of-Marks ONLY on
HTML5 <canvas>, shadow-DOM datepickers, Citrix/RDP, or DOM action failure
• Result: 9.8s/task (3.67x faster) · $0.043/task (-79.5%) · 96.2% Task Success!
2. 200-Session Chromium Pool & Zero-Credential Handoff
Headless Chromium Container Pool Sizing (200 Concurrent Sessions)
• Per Browser Context: 650 MB RAM + 0.35 vCPU (with /dev/shm=2GB & media block)
• 200 Sessions = 13× K8s CPU Worker Nodes (8 vCPU / 16 GB) = $2,600/mo
GPU Inference Pool for 200 Concurrent Active Browser Agents
• AXTree Text LLM Pool (85% steps): 2× H100-80GB ($4,600/mo)
• Vision CUA Fallback Pool (15% steps, UI-TARS-14B): 2× L40S-48GB ($1,900/mo)
Zero-Password SSO / MFA / Captcha Human-in-the-Loop WebRTC Handoff
• Never pass user plaintext passwords into LLM prompts! Pause agent on MFA/SSO
screen, stream interactive WebRTC/noVNC view for user click, then resume agent
3. Total TCO Comparison (200 Concurrent Sessions · 300,000 Automated Workflows/Month)
• Managed Cloud Browser-Agent SaaS ($0.15/session-min) + Pure Vision CUA API = $63,000/month.
• Self-Hosted 13× CPU Nodes ($2.6k) + 2× H100 ($4.6k) + 2× L40S ($1.9k) = $9,100/month ($0.030/workflow, saving 85.6%!).
